scope: Ring-3 MM oracle at 8 and 16 vCPUs, and the remote-holder leg repeated 300 times at 8 vCPUs
limitations: TCG (no KVM) on a shared 40-core dev host; up to six lanes ran at once
QEMU interrupt logs are not kept; their last 2 MB are retained on the host next to the logs
logs stay on the dev host under /tmp/nilix-evidence/st-k2-p2/8f9d736; only their SHA-256 is recorded here
notes: All 300 remote-holder rounds passed (ST-K2-REMOTE-HOLDER-ACK PASS reps=300); the guest then hung inside the final-owner leg. Symbolized hot PCs: Scheduler::lock_ready_queue_or_defer, Scheduler::reschedule_now, arch::smp::ap_idle_loop, SocketTable::drain_deferred_port_uncharges, the same signature as the 16-vCPU hang on main. The rerun 8f9d736-r300b passed completely.
